Here we look a changes over time for individual species as well as for the aggregate.  We bin abundance into a hexagonal mesh covering the area, compute long term means and the examine trends over time relative to each mean. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("setup.R")
```


```{r load_data}
x = read_ecomon_spp(form = 'sf') |> ecomon_to_long()
h = read_hexgrid()
```

# Total

```{r total_abundance}
abund = tally_abundance(x, h, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE, transform = log1p)
plot(abund)
```
